title: Markdown to HTML converter
issue: After a deploy, table-of-contents links stopped working on some pages of the docs site (the anchors no longer match), bold text looks broken in the changelog, and some pages end with a strange extra bullet list.

bugs.summary: Strong/emphasis regexes are greedy, so two spans on one line merge.
The heading-id counter is module-level and never reset, so ids drift between documents and between toHtml and toc.
collectList stops at tokens.length - 1, splitting a list that ends the document.
